name: Ask Miki for help
descriptionshort: Deals programming damage to one target.
descriptionlarge: Miki descends from the heavens of EDA to make your algorithm more efficient.

name: Yellow Paint
descriptionshort: Deals damage to all three enemies. The selected enemy takes increased damage, while the others receive a reduced fraction of the original damage.
descriptionlarge: Covers your game with yellow stains so the player doesn't get lost or frustrated.

name: Talk About Your Feelings
descriptionshort: You recover part of your aura.
descriptionlarge: You sit down and talk to your duck about life's difficulties and problems.

name: Duck
descriptionshort: Freezes the selected enemy in its current position, preventing it from attacking you
descriptionlarge: You shout at your duck in the cafeteria. Everyone stares, but who cares? You've got a mojito and a duck.

name: Recursion
descriptionshort: Deal programming damage to a selected target and gain an extra turn to attack again.
descriptionlarge: Write a recursive function that makes your code more efficient and beautiful!

name: Planing poker
descriptionshort: Deals design damage to one active enemies.
descriptionlarge: You play poker with Ismael and Marco Crespo. After sharing ideas and debating, your mind feels more relaxed.

name: FEDEEEEEEEEEEEEEE
descriptionshort: Deals design damage to one active enemies.
descriptionlarge: Ask Fede for advice on how to trick players convincingly during the game. He calls NVIDIA's CEO for help.

name: Kidnap Camilo
descriptionshort: Deals super effective design damage design damage to one active enemies.
descriptionlarge: Force Camilo to draw your game's artwork. His impressive drawings improve gameplay quality.

name: Celia
descriptionshort: Deals super effective desing damage to one active enemies.
descriptionlarge: Tired of making no progress, you call Celia, who already programmed your entire game two weeks ago and gives you hints on how to proceed.

name: Arturo
descriptionshort: Deals super effective management  damage to one active enemies.
descriptionlarge: Overwhelmed by the lack of help, Arturo arrives with his goblins to organize your project. You've never seen such a tidy Product Backlog!
